css: .print-format { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: #111827; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.35; } .kpi-title { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 14px; } .kpi-title h1 { font-size: 18px; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .4px; } .kpi-title .subtitle { margin-top: 4px; color: #4b5563; font-size: 11px; } .kpi-band { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; padding: 7px 9px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 12px 0 0; } .kpi-grid { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 10px; } .kpi-grid td, .kpi-grid th { border: 1px solid #d1d5db; padding: 6px 7px; vertical-align: top; } .kpi-grid th { background: #f3f4f6; font-weight: 700; } .kpi-label { width: 18%; background: #f9fafb; font-weight: 700; color: #374151; } .kpi-value { width: 32%; } .kpi-score-card { display: table; width: 100%; margin: 10px 0 12px; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 7px 0; } .kpi-score-cell { display: table-cell; width: 25%; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; padding: 8px; text-align: center; } .kpi-score-label { color: #6b7280; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; } .kpi-score-value { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 3px; } .kpi-rating { background: #ecfdf5; border-color: #10b981; color: #065f46; } .kpi-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 0; } .kpi-table th, .kpi-table td { border: 1px solid #d1d5db; padding: 5px 6px; vertical-align: top; } .kpi-table th { background: #e5e7eb; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; } .text-right { text-align: right; } .text-center { text-align: center; } .kpi-muted { color: #6b7280; } .kpi-box { min-height: 54px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; padding: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .kpi-signature { height: 42px; border-bottom: 1px solid #111827; margin-bottom: 4px; } .kpi-small { font-size: 10px; } .page-break { page-break-before: always; }
